name: DriftStop: Motivation Quotes
subtitle: Stoic wisdom at the right time
promotionalText: Seven days of Pro on every new install — no card, no sign-up. 4,325 quotes, arriving when you least expect them.
description:
A quote you didn't ask for, at a moment you didn't plan.

DriftStop doesn't wait for you to open it. It sends you a line of hard-won wisdom at random times through your day — while you're stuck, bored, or about to give up on something. That timing is the whole point. Advice you go looking for is easy to ignore. Advice that arrives unannounced tends to land.

WHAT YOU GET FREE
• 1,000 quotes from Marcus Aurelius, Seneca, Confucius, Lao Tzu and dozens more
• 3 reminders a day, at times you never see coming
• Pick the themes you want: discipline, resilience, focus, wisdom, peace, motivation, reckoning, legacy
• Set your own quiet hours and skip weekends
• Save what hits, revisit what you've already seen

DRIFTSTOP PRO
• 3,325+ premium quotes across 18 curated collections — the Stoics, Ancient Greek Philosophers, Eastern Wisdom, and more
• Up to 10 reminders a day
• No ads
• Browse by author across the whole catalogue

Every new install starts with 7 days of Pro. No card, no sign-up, nothing to cancel. When the week is over the app keeps working — just with fewer quotes a day.

An account is optional. Everything works as a guest; signing in only means your Pro access follows you to a new phone.

Interface: English, Turkish, Spanish, German, French and Italian. Quote text is available in English and Turkish.

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
DriftStop Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, available monthly (US$3.99) or yearly (US$35.99). Prices are shown in your local currency and may vary by region. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings after purchase.
